title: Question 24
passage:
Are the nuts in the filling or just on top?
A. The filling is made with apples. B. We can cut you a smaller piece. C. Just on top. We add them after baking.
passageZh:
堅果有放在內餡裡，還是只撒在表面？
A. 內餡是用蘋果做的。 B. 我們可以切小一點的一塊給你。 C. 只在表面。烤好後才加上去。
